title: Private Customizable Niagara Falls Wine Tasting Adventure
includes: Hotel pickup and drop-off (selected hotels only)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
A current valid passport is required on the day of travel
Collapsible wheelchairs with removable wheels can be accommodated providing the passenger is accompanied by someone who can assist them board and disembark
Children Under 14 Years of Age must be accompanied by an Adult
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Private, Custom, Upscale Tour: 

This tour provides you with the freedom to explore up to 5 premium wineries and/or breweries

Discover the best of Niagara with our exclusive, tailor-made, private, customizable tour designed just for you.

Exclusive Niagara Experience: 
Enjoy door-to-door service with a professional licensed driver/guide in an upscale private vehicle.

Flexible Timing and Personalized Itineraries: 
Craft your perfect day by choosing from your favourite attractions and popular Niagara sites. We handle all reservations and planning for a smooth, stress-free experience.

Note: Food and beverage, winery/brewery tasting fees, and attraction ticketing fees are not included in the tour price.

Book your exclusive tour today and embark on an unforgettable adventure!
